newsitem.title: USA: Misonix in pact with U.S. Surgical.
newsitem.headline: Misonix in pact with U.S. Surgical.

text.p: Misonix Inc said it agreed to license its ultrasonic cutting technology, which uses high frequency sound waves to coagulate and divide tissue for both open and laparoscopic surgery, to U.S. Surgical Corp .

The pact would give U.S. Surgical exclusive worldwide marketing and sales rights for the technology and give Misonix aggregate license fees, over time, of about $500,000 plus royalties based upon net sales of such products.
Misonix shares jumped over 26 percent, up one to 4-3/4. They hit a new high of 5-3/8 in heavy intraday trading.
